files.README.md:
Claude Code Plugin for Context Markets

MCP server, expert skills, and API reference in one install.

## Install ```bash claude plugin marketplace add contextwtf/context-plugin claude plugin install context-plugin@context-markets ``` ## Setup ```bash export CONTEXT_API_KEY="your-api-key" export CONTEXT_PRIVATE_KEY="0x..." # for trading ``` No API key needed for read-only research workflows. Need a key? Visit [context.markets](https://context.markets). ## What's Included ### MCP Server The plugin automatically starts the Context MCP server (`context-markets-mcp`) with 17 tools for market data, trading, and account management. ### Skills | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/context-plugin:trade` | Order placement, bulk operations, orderbook strategies | | `/context-plugin:research` | Market discovery, oracle analysis, price history | | `/context-plugin:build` | React components, wallet integration, frontend patterns | | `/context-plugin:create` | Market creation from natural language questions | ### Reference Files - `api-reference.md` — Full SDK method signatures for all modules - `patterns.md` — Common workflows, error handling, and gotchas - `examples.md` — Copy-paste TypeScript scripts for common tasks - `react-hooks.md` — React SDK hook signatures and usage patterns ## Usage Use natural language or slash commands: ``` "Find active markets about AI regulation" "Place a $10 buy order on YES at 45 cents for market abc123" "Show my portfolio and unrealized PnL" ``` ## Documentation - **[Plugin Guide](https://docs.context.markets/agents/plugin)** — setup, configuration, and usage ## Ecosystem | Package | Description | |---------|-------------| | **[context-markets](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-sdk)** | TypeScript SDK for trading | | **[context-markets-react](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-react)** | React hooks for market data and trading | | **[context-markets-mcp](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-mcp)** | MCP server for AI agents | | **[context-markets-cli](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-cli)** | CLI for trading from the terminal | | **[context-skills](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-skills)** | AI agent skill files | | **[context-plugin](https://github.com/contextwtf/context-plugin)** | Claude Code plugin | ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE) for details.
